In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] '''traveled''' to the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seoul 5]] in search of valuable [[Seoularian crystal|crystals]] but instead ended up freeing a pair of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] that attacked him.<ref name="SW84" />
